name: Death And Dying
overview: Scripture reveals that death is a transition overseen by God, who values the death of His saints as precious and sovereign. While the body returns to dust, the spirit returns to God, the giver of life, affirming the hope of resurrection to everlasting life or judgment as shown in Daniel. Believers need not fear physical death, for Jesus promises eternal fellowship with Him in paradise, emphasizing the eternal security of the soul beyond bodily death.
